interpretation: Rank768 has ample held-out representation capacity on the improved interface, but the fixed linear coefficient map cannot recover its coefficients. The remaining local bottleneck is nonlinear coefficient prediction.
decision: Preserve the fixed linear map as a baseline path and authorize one no-model feasibility audit for a zero-output nonlinear residual coefficient predictor at rank768, combined with the frozen dual width192 attention paths. No fit is authorized until the final-system envelope passes.
claim_boundary: Read-only layer-1 bottleneck isolation only; no artifact, English quality, runtime, Phase 3 certificate, or superiority claim.
